title: Installation Registration v1
description: Still INACTIVE as a standalone endpoint in Phase 6 (POST /api/v1/installation-registration, app/api/routes.py, still returns 501). Phase 6's real activation flow (activation-request-v1.schema.json) registers the installation IMPLICITLY as part of a successful activation -- there is deliberately no separate registration call in the live protocol. This schema remains as a specification for a possible future explicit-registration variant, not something any current client should call.
